exact_finding: Native/miss external asset count 85; hit 86. The hit adds atomic-widgets-action-link-handler.min.js although no action link is present.
cause: Atomic policy reads dependencies from unbound registered prototypes. Native Has_Atomic_Base::has_action_link() returns true when get_id() is empty; actual rendered elements do not request this handler for ordinary post URLs.
proposed_fix: Collect Atomic dependencies from actual rendered instances/queue deltas on a miss, including real root dependencies; do not enqueue the unbound prototype dependency superset. Repeat HTML/assets/interaction acceptance afterward.
